items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: So I met Holly Hofmann, who was a wonderful mentor for me there.

ctx.x: So after you got your education up to the point where you felt pretty confident, did you have to choose between the East Coast and the West Coast? Or did it just kind of happen for you that you ended up—

Well by the time I had my master’s I was already working. My goal was while I was in school I was trying to get out of school as fast as possible, musically speaking. So while I was doing my studies, because I was watching the people around me that weren’t necessarily there — they weren’t jazzers, it’s not a jazz school. But I would see them with the avant garde thing. And they would be so intent on the performances for those school concerts and those ensembles at school that they never saw the community. They…
There’s a few other good fellas there and players in San Diego.
